draft.subject: Notes that hold up when the payer asks
draft.body:
Maria,

Most denials happen weeks after the session, when an auditor decides the note doesn't support the code.

JotPsych checks every note against 150+ payer rules before you submit it. It flags audit risk in the documentation itself — missing elements, weak support for the CPT code, misalignment with your contracted rates.

The system scans for the things auditors look for. You fix it before it becomes a denial.

Works with any EHR. Or replaces it entirely. Add JotPsych to the system you have today: no migration, up in 5 minutes.

Worth another look?

Liam
JotPsych

--
